title: Dissectors: fix or suppress some more script warnings

notes.body:
added 2 commits
  • c39c367c - 1 commit from branch wireshark:master
  • 655b5553 - Dissectors: fix or suppress some more script warnings
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/24661/diffs?diff_id=1774627602&start_sha=387678ec12ff427c7db9fe7ad4c46c42fa92ffca)
enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
